system.boundary: Build a closed-loop battery-electric-vehicle thermal-management model with one physically connected vehicle/e-drive plant, battery pack, traction motor, DC/DC converter, cabin thermal mass, coolant circuits, and a vapor-compression refrigerant circuit.
engineering_objects: Build a closed-loop battery-electric-vehicle thermal-management model with one physically connected vehicle/e-drive plant, battery pack, traction motor, DC/DC converter, cabin thermal mass, coolant circuits, and a vapor-compression refrigerant circuit.
Vehicle speed must causally load the e-drive and its thermal states.
Before simulation, read bev_drive_command and bev_thermal_command from the MATLAB base workspace.
physical_paths: Build a closed-loop battery-electric-vehicle thermal-management model with one physically connected vehicle/e-drive plant, battery pack, traction motor, DC/DC converter, cabin thermal mass, coolant circuits, and a vapor-compression refrigerant circuit.

The coolant and refrigerant paths must exchange heat through connected heat exchangers and use measured cabin and component temperatures to coordinate the fan, compressor, motor coolant pump, battery coolant pump, and cabin blower.
Every public input field must affect its corresponding connected environment, load, controller, or plant path.
Vehicle speed must causally load the e-drive and its thermal states.
functional_paths: Every public input field must affect its corresponding connected environment, load, controller, or plant path.
information_paths: bev_drive_command, bev_thermal_command -> EXT-XTHERM-BEV-MULTILOOP-01 plant/control path -> bev_vehicle_response, bev_temperature_response, bev_heat_flow_response, bev_actuator_response
modes_and_events: Build a closed-loop battery-electric-vehicle thermal-management model with one physically connected vehicle/e-drive plant, battery pack, traction motor, DC/DC converter, cabin thermal mass, coolant circuits, and a vapor-compression refrigerant circuit.
The same architecture must respond causally to changes in cabin setpoint, A/C enable, recirculation mode, and occupant load.

interfaces.name: bev_drive_command

interfaces.name: bev_thermal_command
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Before simulation, read bev_drive_command and bev_thermal_command from the MATLAB base workspace. bev_thermal_command is a scalar struct with ambient_temperature_degC in 25--40 degC, relative_humidity in 0.35--0.70, cabin_setpoint_degC in 22--30 degC, integer occupant_count in 1--5, and logical ac_enable and recirculation_enable in {0,1}.

interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: bev_temperature_response has width 6: [cabin, ambient, cabin setpoint, maximum battery, DC/DC, motor temperature] in degC.
